arxiv-2009-02089.title: Massive Machine Type Communication Pilot-Hopping Sequence Detection Architectures Based on Non-Negative Least Squares for Grant-Free Random Access Thanks: Manuscript received August 8, 2026. This work was supported in part by the ELLIIT strategic research environment. Thanks: The authors are with th
arxiv-2009-02089.creator: Narges Mohammadi Sarband, Ema Becirovic, Mattias Krysander
arxiv-2009-02089.description: Abstract User activity detection in grant-free random access massive machine type communication (mMTC) using pilot-hopping sequences can be formulated as solving a non-negative least squares (NNLS) problem. In this work, two architectures using different algorithms to solve the NNLS problem is proposed.

arxiv-2106-05644.title: Optimal Non-Convex Exact Recovery in Stochastic Block Model via Projected Power Method
arxiv-2106-05644.creator: Peng Wang, Huikang Liu, Zirui Zhou, Anthony Man-Cho So
arxiv-2106-05644.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the problem of exact community recovery in the symmetric stochastic block model, where a graph of n n vertices is randomly generated by partitioning the vertices into K ≥ 2 K\geq 2 equal-sized communities and then connecting each pair of vertices with probability that depends on their community memberships.

arxiv-2208-07849.title: RR Lyrae stars in the globular cluster Palomar 2
arxiv-2208-07849.creator: A. Arellano Ferro, I. Bustos Fierro, S. Muneer, S. Giridhar
arxiv-2208-07849.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Arellano Ferro, I. Bustos Fierro, S. Muneer, S. Giridhar. Empleando una serie temporal de 10 años de imágenes CCD VI , exploramos las curvas de luz de estrellas en el campo del cúmulo. Descubrimos 20 RRab y 1 RRc. Una revisión de los datos de G ​ a ​ i ​ a Gaia -DR3 permitió identificar 11 variables más y confirmar la naturaleza RRab de 6 de ellas y una RGB.

arxiv-2308-03923.title: Stabilizing two-qubit entanglement with dynamically decoupled active feedback
arxiv-2308-03923.creator: Sacha Greenfield 1,2,3, Leigh Martin 4,5, Felix Motzoi 4,6,7, K. Birgitta Whaley 4,6, Justin Dressel 3,8, Eli M. Levenson-Falk 1,2,9
arxiv-2308-03923.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sacha Greenfield 1,2,3, Leigh Martin 4,5, Felix Motzoi 4,6,7, K. Birgitta Whaley 4,6, Justin Dressel 3,8, Eli M. Levenson-Falk 1,2,9. We propose and analyze a protocol for stabilizing a maximally entangled state of two noninteracting qubits using active state-dependent feedback from a continuous two-qubit half-parity measurement in coordination with a concurrent, non-commuting dynamical decoupling drive. We demonstrate that such a drive can be simultaneous with the measurement and feedback, while also playing a key part in the feedback protocol itself.

arxiv-2401-17212.title: ContactGen: Contact-Guided Interactive 3D Human Generation for Partners
arxiv-2401-17212.creator: Dongjun Gu, Jaehyeok Shim, Jaehoon Jang, Changwoo Kang, Kyungdon Joo
arxiv-2401-17212.description: Abstract Among various interactions between humans, such as eye contact and gestures, physical interactions by contact can act as an essential moment in understanding human behaviors. Inspired by this fact, given a 3D partner human with the desired interaction label, we introduce a new task of 3D human generation in terms of physical contact.

arxiv-2404-05816.title: Centrality Estimators for Probability Density Functions
arxiv-2404-05816.description: Abstract In this report, we explore the data selection leading to a family of estimators maximizing a centrality. The family allows a nice properties leading to accurate and robust probability density function fitting according to some criteria we define. We establish a link between the centrality estimator and the maximum likelihood, showing that the latter is a particular case.

arxiv-2404-08473.title: Convergence of Power Sequences of operators via their stability Thanks: The research of the first and fourth authors was supported by the National Science Center (NCN) Grant OPUS No. DEC-2021/43/B/ST1/01651. The research of the second author was supported by Basic Science Research Program through th
arxiv-2404-08473.creator: Zenon Jan Jabłoński, Il Bong Jung, Carlos Kubrusly, Jan Stochel
arxiv-2404-08473.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with the convergence of power sequences and stability of Hilbert space operators, where “convergence” and “stability” refer to weak, strong and norm topologies. It is proved that an operator has a convergent power sequence if and only if it is a (not necessarily orthogonal) direct sum of an identity operator and a stable operator.

arxiv-2506-20227.title: Orbital chiral lasing in twisted bilayer metasurfaces
arxiv-2506-20227.creator: Mingjin Wang, Nianyuan Lv, Zixuan Zhang, Ye Chen, Jiahao Si, Jingxuan Chen, Chenyan Tang, Xuefan Yin, Zhen Liu, Dongxu Xin, Zhaozheng Yi, Wanhua Zheng, Yuri Kivshar, Chao Peng
arxiv-2506-20227.description: Abstract Chirality is a fundamental concept in physics that underpins various phenomena in nonlinear optics, quantum physics, and topological photonics. Although the spin of a photon naturally brings chirality, orbital angular momentum can also become chirally active in the structures with a broken mirror symmetry.

arxiv-2510-04422.title: The smallest eigenvalue of β \beta -Laguerre and β \beta -Jacobi ensembles and multivariate orthogonal polynomials
arxiv-2510-04422.creator: Sungwoo Jeong
arxiv-2510-04422.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sungwoo Jeong. We study the smallest eigenvalue statistics of the β \beta -Laguerre and β \beta -Jacobi ensembles. Using Kaneko’s integral formula, we show that the smallest eigenvalue marginal density and distribution functions of the two ensembles for any β > 0 \beta>0 can be represented in terms of multivariate Laguerre and Jacobi polynomials evaluated at a multiple of the identity, provided that the exponent of x x in the Laguerre and Jacobi weights is an integer.

arxiv-2510-05670.title: Quantifying the Accuracy–Interpretability Trade-Off in Concept-Based Sidechannel Models
arxiv-2510-05670.creator: David Debot, Giuseppe Marra
arxiv-2510-05670.description: Abstract Concept Bottleneck Models (CBNMs) are deep learning models that provide interpretability by enforcing a bottleneck layer where predictions are based exclusively on human-understandable concepts. However, this constraint also restricts information flow and often results in reduced predictive accuracy. Concept Sidechannel Models (CSMs) address this limitation by introducing a sidechannel that bypasses the bottleneck and carry additional task-relevant information.

britannica-1911-william-of-malmesbury.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-william-of-malmesbury.description: Article 'William of Malmesbury' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. determination of the states of Holland to conclude a peace so advantageous to their trade interests. William, however, speedily opened secret negotiations with France in the hope of securing the armed assistance of that power for the carrying out of his ambitious projects of a war of aggrandisement against the Spanish Netherlands and of a restoration of his brother-in-law, Charles II., to the throne of England.

pmc-11363728.title: Frontal alpha asymmetry predicts subsequent social decision-making: A dynamic multilevel, neural, and developmental perspective
pmc-11363728.creator: Rebecca Revilla, Cailee M Nelson, Nicole R Friedman, Summer S Braun, Caitlin M Hudac
pmc-11363728.description: Social motivation, the human desire to engage with others, is likely to underlie higher levels of social cognition and the formation of interpersonal relationships. Yet, this topic has been understudied in adolescents despite the critical developmental and maturational changes that occur during this period and the relevance of social motivation to clinical and neurodevelopmental disorders.

pmc-11385782.title: Exploring the transactive relationships of influence factors for online asynchronous learning transactive memory system
pmc-11385782.creator: Jiao Zhang, Min Zhao, Liang Wang
pmc-11385782.description: Transactive memory system (TMS) makes learning and transferring knowledge easy and efficient. This study has constructed a conceptual model of TMS to reveal the crucial factors influencing the formation of a TMS in online asynchronous learning to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration and enhance knowledge transfer effectiveness.

pmc-11534700.title: Sodium danshensu modulates skeletal muscle fiber type formation and metabolism by inhibiting pyruvate kinase M1
pmc-11534700.creator: Yunxia Zhang, Xiaoxiao Wu, Ruoqi Li, Mengru Sui, Guoyin Li, Shuhua Fan, Mingsheng Yang, Qiuping Liu, Xiaomeng Liu, Changjing Wu, Lili Li
pmc-11534700.description: Sodium Danshensu (SDSS) is extracted from Salvia miltiorrhiza and has many pharmacological effects. However, little is known about its effects on muscle fiber formation and metabolism. Here, we aimed to investigated the role and molecular mechanisms of SDSS in modulating the formation of skeletal muscle fiber. C2C12 cells were incubated in differentiation medium with or without SDSS for 4 days.

pmc-11616594.title: Effect of electroacupuncture on internal carotid artery blood flow in patients undergoing laparoscopic gallbladder surgery: A randomized clinical trial
pmc-11616594.creator: Lili Hu, Yongyan Zhang, Ying Li, Ruiping Wang, Hua Xu
pmc-11616594.description: BackgroundLittle is known about the effect of electroacupuncture (EA) on cerebral blood flow. We investigated this question in patients undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy, hypothesizing that EA would increase cerebral blood flow during surgery.MethodsEighty-two patients undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy were randomly divided into receiving electroacupuncture and intravenous anesthesia (EA+IA) and receving intravenous anesthesia alone (IA).

pmc-12522124.title: Exploring the Limits of Passive Macromolecular Translocation through Phospholipid Membranes
pmc-12522124.creator: Ekaterina Kostyurina, Ralf Biehl, Margarita Kruteva, Alexandros Koutsioubas, Henrich Frielinghaus, Nageshwar Rao Yepuri, Stephan Förster, Jürgen Allgaier
pmc-12522124.description: Transportation of active macromolecules through cell membranes is an essential biological process. However, for hydrophilic macromolecules, the hydrophobic interior of lipid bilayers suppresses the passive translocation, and there are only few cases reported. We use alternating amphiphilic polymers (AAPs) in which the sizes of the hydrophilic and hydrophobic units can be varied over a broad range, keeping the polymers water-soluble.

pmc-12852670.title: k-dependent modulation of intrinsic spin-orbit interaction in MoSe2 induced by proximity to amorphous Pb
pmc-12852670.creator: Fatima Alarab, Ján Minár, Procopios Constantinou, Dhani Nafday, Aki Pulkkinen, Thorsten Schmitt, Xiaoqiang Wang, Vladimir N. Strocov
pmc-12852670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Tuning the strength of spin-orbit interaction (SOI) is pivotal for developing next-generation spintronic and quantum devices. Proximity-induced SOI is a promising route toward this goal, but its experimental characterization with resolution in k-space using ARPES remains challenging. We advance previous ARPES investigations of proximity-induced SOI in graphene-based systems to transition-metal dichalcogenides (MoSe2) in proximity to an amorphous overlayer of high-Z metal (Pb) whose disordered nature suppresses k-space mismatch at the interface.

pmc-12983385.title: The mouth as a window: A multi-center retrospective study of oral extraintestinal manifestations of IBD and their management
pmc-12983385.creator: Miguel A Aristizabal-Torres, Marketa Janovska, Lauren P Loeb, Yaohua Ma, Roy S Rogers-III, Francis A Farraye, Alison J Bruce, Victor Chedid, Jana G Hashash, Katherine J Bodiford
pmc-12983385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUp to 50% of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) have associated oral extraintestinal manifestations (OEIMs). We aim to describe the prevalence of OEIMs in IBD and propose a therapeutic algorithm.Material and MethodsElectronic health records of adult patients with IBD who presented with at least one oral symptom between January 2017 and November 2021 at a tri-state tertiary academic medical center were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-13063864.title: Response to: Matters Arising in relation to “Evaluating agreement between individual nutrition randomised controlled trials and cohort studies – a meta-epidemiological study”
pmc-13063864.creator: Julia Stadelmaier, Gina Bantle, Lea Gorenflo, Eva Kiesswetter, Adriani Nikolakopoulou, Lukas Schwingshackl
pmc-13063864.description: We respond to the Matters Arising article by Calkins et al. commenting on our meta-epidemiological study “Evaluating agreement between individual nutrition randomised controlled trials and cohort studies”. We appreciate the opportunity to respond to the points raised and to clarify the methods and interpretation of our work.

pmc-13098105.title: Time‐related differences and influencing factors of acute stress symptoms in university students exposed to suicide
pmc-13098105.creator: Isamu Yamazaki, Tohru Takahashi, Daimei Sasayama, Hiroshi Morita, Shinsuke Washizuka
pmc-13098105.description: AimAlthough clarifying the immediate psychological impact on students exposed to suicide is essential, standardized suicide postvention protocols in university settings are currently lacking. This study examined the temporal differences and contributing factors in the psychological impact of suicide exposure among university students using postvention records from a single Japanese university.

pmc-13185188.title: Late-onset dyskeratosis congenita due to a TERC (n.269G > C) variant—first reported case from Indonesia: a case report
pmc-13185188.creator: Benedreky Leo, Intan Hartandy, Susanna Hilda Hutajulu, Mardiah Suci Hardianti, Kartika Widayati, Johan Kurnianda, Ibnu Purwanto
pmc-13185188.description: BackgroundDyskeratosis congenita (DC) is a rare inherited bone marrow failure syndrome caused by defective telomere maintenance. It often presents with mucocutaneous features, cytopenias, and progressive organ involvement, but remains underrecognized in resource-limited settings.Case presentationWe report a 32-year-old Indonesian male of Javanese ethnicity who presented with progressive anemia, thrombocytopenia, and bilateral hip pain.
